name: Discord
_comment1: Discord registers TWO mixer sliders under one exe path. The Chromium audio service process owns notification sounds; the renderer owns voice chat output (its voice engine opens WASAPI directly). They are indistinguishable by session identifier, display name, icon or grouping param, so processMatch picks them apart by process command line.
_comment2: ORDER MATTERS. Both sessions share one session identifier, which is the key Windows stores the level under, so only one value survives a restart and Windows restores it to BOTH sliders. Targets are applied in order and the last one wins the stored value. Notifications go LAST so the remembered level is the quiet one: a launch before this script runs then comes up quiet (harmless) instead of loud (the bug).
